race.comment: CZECH OUT (2) settled midfield then made good inroads to finish fourth when resuming over 1100m at Morphettville last start. Anchored by 59.5kgs that day so down to 57.5kgs helps. Placed in a Listed race when second-up last prep which is an outstanding form line. Looks a bit better than these. The Stokes-trained OUR BRAVE BOY (7), first-up from a 15-week break is the obvious danger. Showed pace and held on for second when fresh last prep over this trip at Caulfield Heath. Trialling well and should be prominent for a long way. UPSANDDOWNS (10) did his best work late to get up for third on debut recently over 1100m at this track. Tackling Saturday grade this time and coming back in trip isn't perfect, but there is a stack of room for improvement. ASTERNAL LOVE (16) disappointed at $1.95 on debut here 17 days ago. Deserves another chance. CRAZYABOUTZOU (12) has only raced once and should be ready to run well off a seven-month break after a nice jump-out at Morphettville recently.
